preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 3.
The number of old cities K must be between 2 and N, and N must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of newer roads M must be between 0 and 100,000.
The city S where Limak lives must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= N and 1 <= b_i <= N and 1 <= c_i <= 1000000000 for a_i, b_i, c_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid cities and have a length between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N integers representing the distances from city S to each city.
The distance from city S to itself must be 0.
All distances must be non-negative integers.
